meta.name: lince-goose-paranoid
meta.description: Goose paranoid: only LLM providers known to nono's credential proxy (anthropic, openai) are reachable; ~/.config/goose, ~/.local/share/goose, and ~/.local/state/goose isolated to a per-agent scratch HOME. Goose supports many providers (Z.ai via ZHIPU_API_KEY, Google, etc.) but only the ones with built-in credential injection ship in paranoid — for others ship a custom level fragment that extends network.allow_domain and environment.passthrough.
